title: MainSystemExtensions
author: JG
description: expose MainSystem as MainSystemBase into python; derive Python class MainSystem from MainSystemBase in MainSystemExtensions; this should increase visibility of Python code!
releaseNotes: Resolved differently and the goal is met: instead of exposing MainSystemBase and deriving a Python MainSystem from it; a function is marked where it is defined with @extends(exudyn.MainSystem) and exudyn.extensionRegistry.install() attaches it to the C++ class (revision2026 phase R4). Python-side MainSystem code is therefore visible in the class; in the stub file and in the documentation; without a second class in the hierarchy.
